protocol.reference_matrix: arithmetic mean of shrunk training FC only
protocol.distance: affine-invariant Riemannian distance, equal to the Frobenius norm of log(R^(-1/2) C_tilde R^(-1/2))
protocol.validation_auc_source: locked BrainNetMLP gamma trials from the standard-five-fold main experiment; unavailable by design for gamma=0.95 here

airm_validation_auc_association.interpretation_scope: descriptive association across locked validation trials; not a causal estimate and not a test-set selection rule
